title: easyrules
description: Adds a clickable in-chat menu to toggle world rules — keep inventory, fire/fall/hunger/drowning damage, mob griefing, day & weather cycle, difficulty. New worlds start with Keep Inventory on. Bilingual EN/RU.
body:
# EasyRules

  A lightweight **quality-of-life** mod for **Minecraft 1.12.2 (Forge)** that turns
  the most common world rules into a **clickable in-chat menu** — and starts every
  new world with **Keep Inventory ON**. Fully bilingual: **English / Русский**
  (it follows your selected game language automatically).

  ## ✨  Features

  - **Auto Keep Inventory** — the first time a world loads, item-keeping is turned
    on, so you never lose your stuff on a fresh world. Turn it off anytime; your
    choice is saved per world.
  - **Welcome button** — on join you get a clickable `[ Open rules menu ]`.
  - **Live chat menu** — type `/rules` and every value becomes a button. Click it
    to toggle the rule; the menu instantly redraws. Hover any rule for a description.
  - **`/rules help`** — prints a full explanation of every rule.

  ## 🎛️ Rules you can toggle

  | Rule | What it does |
  |------|--------------|
  | Keep inventory | keep items & XP on death |
  | Fire damage | fire / lava / burning on or off |
  | Fall damage | fall damage on or off |
  | Drowning | underwater suffocation on or off |
  | Hunger damage | starvation on or off |
  | Mob griefing | creepers / endermen changing blocks |
  | Day-night cycle | freeze or run time |
  | Weather cycle | freeze or run weather |
  | Difficulty | Peaceful / Easy / Normal / Hard |

  ## ⌨️ Commands

  /rules                 open the menu
  /rules help            show explanations
  /rules difficulty <peaceful|easy|normal|hard>
  Aliases: `/er`, `/easyrules`. Usable in singleplayer even without cheats.

  ## 🌍 Languages

  English and Русский out of the box. Text is translated on the client, so each
  player sees the menu in their own game language.

  ## 📦 Compatibility

  - **Minecraft 1.12.2**, **Forge**
  - **Server side: required · Client side: optional** (client only needed for
    translated text)
  - **No dependencies** — works standalone or in any modpack.
